blocks.text: We have received your sickness absence notification
Dear {{worker.first_name}}, thank you for letting us know that you are unwell. We have recorded your absence starting {{leave.start_date}}.
Please keep your manager updated if anything changes. {{clause:sickness_evidence_reminder}}
You do not need to tell your manager your diagnosis. Any medical evidence you give us is stored securely and seen only by people who need it.
We wish you a speedy recovery.
